40016590.author: पदार्थः
40016590.content: ततः then, महातेजाः of extraordinary energy, वीर्यवान् prodigious, रामः Rama, धनुः bow, आदाय taking, किरीटिनम् adorned with crown, महाकायम् of large size, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, ददर्श saw.

40016590.author: Translation
40016590.content: On taking up a bow Rama saw Kumbhakarna of extraordinary energy, prodigious, and of large body, adorned with a crown.

40016591.author: पदार्थः
40016591.content: पर्वताकारदर्शनम् like a mountain in appearance, पुरा earlier, आकाशम् sky, क्रममाणम् taking steps, प्रभुम् Lord, नारायणं Narayana, यथा so also, तंराक्षसश्रेष्ठम् that foremost of Rakshasas, दृष्टव I witnessed.

40016591.author: Translation
40016591.content: That foremost of Rakshasas was like a mountain in appearance, it was like Lord Narayana taking steps to the sky earlier.

40016592.author: पदार्थः
40016592.content: सतोयाम्बुदसङ्काशम् like rainy cloud with water, काञ्चनाङ्गदभूषणम् decked with gold ornaments, दृष्टवा seeing, वानराणाम् Vanaras, महाचमूः commander in chief, पुनः again, प्रदुद्राव ran.

40016592.author: Translation
40016592.content: Seeing the Rakshasa who was like a rainy cloud with water, decked with gold ornaments, the commander in chief of Vanaras ran.

40016593.author: पदार्थः
40016593.content: रामः Rama, विद्रुताम् scared, वाहिनीम् army, वर्धमानम् growing big, राक्षसं च and Rakshasas, दृष्टवा seeing, सविस्मय astonished, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, इदम् thus, उवाच ह spoke.

40016593.author: Translation
40016593.content: Seeing the army scared away and the army of Rakshasas growing in size, Rama was astonished and thus spoke to Vibheeshana.

40016594.author: पदार्थः
40016594.content: पर्वतसङ्काशः resembling mountain, किरीटी crowned, हरिलोचनः of tawny eyes, सविद्युत् by lightning, तोयदःइव like rainy cloud, वीरः hero, लङ्कायाम् at Lanka, दृश्यते seen, असौ oh, क who is he.

40016594.author: Translation
40016594.content: "Who is that hero resembling a mountain, a crowned one with tawny eyes, looking like a rainy cloud driven by lightning? He is seen in Lanka."

40016595.author: पदार्थः
40016595.content: महान् remarkable, असौ he is, एकः lone, अत्र there, पृथिव्याम् earth, केतुभूतः comet, दृश्यते appears, यम् him, दृष्टवा on seeing, सर्वे all, वानराः Vanaras, ततस्ततः hither and thither, विद्रवन्ति fleeing.

40016595.author: Translation
40016595.content: "He is seen here like a lone comet on earth. Seeing him the Vanaras are fleeing hither and thither."

40016596.author: पदार्थः
40016596.content: सुमहान् gigantic, असौ he is, क who, रक्षःवा that Rakshasa, यदिवा perhaps, असुरः demon, आचक्षव colossus, मया by me, एवंविधम् this kind, धूतम् messenger, कदाचन not seen, न दृष्टपूर्वम् not seen earlier.

40016596.author: Translation
40016596.content: "Who is he, that gigantic Rakshasa? Is he a demon or perhaps a colossus? No such being was seen by me earlier."

40016597.author: पदार्थः
40016597.content: राजपुत्रेण by the prince, अक्लिष्टकर्मण of unwearied action, रामेण by Rama, संपृष्टः having been asked, महाप्राज्ञः highly intelligent, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, काकुत्थ्सम् to Kakuthsa, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40016597.author: Translation
40016597.content: Asked by the prince Rama, of unwearied action, highly intelligent Vibheeshana spoke.

40016598.author: पदार्थः
40016598.content: येन by him, युद्धे war, वैवस्वतः Vyvasvatha, वासवश्च Vasava's, पराजितः defeated, सः he, एषः that way, विश्रवसः Visrava, पुत्रः son, प्रतापवान् stupendous, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, अस्य his, प्रमाणसदृशः in size, अन्यःराक्षसः other Rakshasas, न विद्यते not known.

40016598.author: Translation
40016598.content: "Vyvasvatha (Lord of death) as well as Vasava (Indra) were defeated by him in war. He is Kumbhakarna, the son of sage Visrava, a stupendous one and there is no other Rakshasa who equals him in size."

40016599.author: पदार्थः
40016599.content: राघव Raghava, एतेन by him, युधि in war, देवाः Devas, दानवाश्च and Danavas, यक्षाः yaksha, भुजङ्गाः Nagas, पिशिताशनाश्च ogres, गन्धर्व Gandharvas, विद्याधर Vidyadharas, किन्नरैश्च Kinneras, सहस्रशः in thousands, सम्प्रभग्नाः were all defeated.

40016599.author: Translation
40016599.content: "O Raghava! In war Devas, Danavas, Yakshas, Nagas, ogres, Gandharvas, Vidydharas, Kinneras in thousands were defeated by him."

40016600.author: पदार्थः
40016600.content: शूलपाणिम् with pike in hand, विरूपाक्षम् fierce eyes, महाबलम् mighty strong, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, स्त्रिदशाः all Devatas, अयम् this, कालःइति death personified, मोहिताः deluded, हन्तुम् to think of killing, न शेकुः not kill.

40016600.author: Translation
40016600.content: "This Kumbhakarna with pike in hand and fierce eyes, is mighty strong. All the Devatas could not kill him, deluded that he is death personified."

40016601.author: पदार्थः
40016601.content: एषः in that way, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, प्रकृत्याः by nature, तेजस्वी energetic, महाबलः mighty, अन्येषाम् of others, राक्षसेन्द्राणाम् Rakshasa kings, बलम् strength, वरदानकृतम् is on account of boons.

40016601.author: Translation
40016601.content: "Kumbhakarna is by nature (by birth) energetic and mighty. The strength of other Rakshasas is on account of their boons received by them."

40016602.author: पदार्थः
40016602.content: जातमात्रेण as he was born, क्षुधार्तेन due to hunger, एतेन all, महात्मना great soul, सत्त्वानाम् created beings, सुबहूनिअपि being strong, सहस्राणि thousands, भक्षितानि were consumed.

40016602.author: Translation
40016602.content: " As soon as he was born, he was hungry and this great soul being strong consumed thousands of created beings."

40016603.author: पदार्थः
40016603.content: तेषु that way, सम्भक्षयमाणेषु was eating every one, प्रजाः people, भयनिपीडिताः out of fear, शक्रम् Indra, शरणंयान्तिस्म sought refuge, तम् they, अर्धम् अपि all about, न्यवेदयन् represented.

40016603.author: Translation
40016603.content: "In that way when Kumbhakarna was devouring, out of fear all people sought the refuge of Indra and represented."

40016604.author: पदार्थः
40016604.content: वज्री armed with thunderbolt, सः he, महेन्द्रः Mahendra, कुपितः enraged, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, वज्रेण at Indra, जघान hurt, शक्रवज्राभिहतः with thunderbolt, महात्मा great self, सः he, चचाल reeled, कोपात् in anger, भृशम् intense, ननाद च roared.

40016604.author: Translation
40016604.content: "Mahendra who was armed with thunderbolt got enraged and hurt Kumbhakarna with thunderbolt. He reeled and roared with the strike."

40016605.author: पदार्थः
40016605.content: वित्रस्ताः alarmed, प्रजाः people, नानद्यमानस्य hearing the lion roar, रक्षसः Rakshasa, तस्यकुम्भकर्णस्य that Kumbhakarna's, निनादम् roar, श्रुत्वा hearing, भूयः became, वितत्रसे scared.

40016605.author: Translation
40016605.content: "People were already afraid of Kumbhakarna, and after hearing the lion roar of this Rakshasa they were even more scared."

40016606.author: पदार्थः
40016606.content: तत्र then, महेन्द्रस्य Mahendra's, कोपात् anger, महाबलः mighty, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, ऐरावतात् Airavatham, दन्तम् tusk, विकृष्य tearing, वासवम् from the mouth, उरसि chest, जघान struck.

40016606.author: Translation
40016606.content: "Then mighty Kumbhakarna, who was enraged, pulled out the tusk of Airavatham and struck at the chest of Indra."

40016607.author: पदार्थः
40016607.content: सः he, वासवः Indra, कुम्भकर्णप्रहारार्तः for Kumbhakarna's hit, विजज्वाल tormented, ततः then, देवाः Devatas, ब्रह्मर्षिदानवाः Brahmarshis, Danavas, सहसा with force, निषेदुः despondent, शक्रश्च Indra's, प्रजाभिःसह accompanied with created beings, स्वयम्भुवः to Brahma, स्थानम् place, ययौ complained.

40016607.author: Translation
40016607.content: "Hit by Kumbhakarna Indra felt tormented. The Devatas, Brahmarshis and Danavas became despondent. Accompanied by created beings they complained to Brahma."

40016608.author: पदार्थः
40016608.content: ते you, प्रजापतेः Brahma, कुम्भकर्णस्य Kumbhakarna's, दौरात्म्यम् ruthless deeds, प्रजानाम् created beings, भक्षणंचापि devouring, दिवौकसाम् insulting, धर्षणं च harshness, आश्रमध्वंसनंचापि also destroying the abodes of sages, भृशम् violently, परस्त्रीहरणम् abducted others' wives, शशंसुः reported.

40016608.author: Translation
40016608.content: "They reported to Brahma about Kumbhakarna's ruthless deeds, devouring created beings, insulting, harsh and also destroying the abodes of sages violently and abducting others' wives."

40016609.author: पदार्थः
40016609.content: ते you, प्रजापतेः Brahma, कुम्भकर्णस्य Kumbhakarna's, दौरात्म्यम् ruthless deeds, प्रजानाम् created beings, भक्षणंचापि devouring, दिवौकसाम् insulting, धर्षणं च harshness, आश्रमध्वंसनंचापि also destroying the abodes of sages, भृशम् violently, परस्त्रीहरणम् abducted others' wives, शशंसुः reported.

40016609.author: Translation
40016609.content: "They reported to Brahma about Kumbhakarna's ruthless deeds, devouring created beings, insulting, harsh and also destroying the abodes of sages violently and abducting others' wives."

40016610.author: पदार्थः
40016610.content: एषः if he, एवम् in that way, नित्यशः every day, प्रजाः created beings, भक्षयिष्यतियदि if consumes, अचिरेण soon, कालेनैव in course of time, लोकः world, शून्यः empty, भविष्यति will become.

40016610.author: Translation
40016610.content: "If he consumes created beings every day like that, in the course of time the world will be devoid of beings."

40016611.author: पदार्थः
40016611.content: सर्वलोकपितामहः Brahma (the grandfather of the whole universe), वासवस्य Indra, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, रक्षांसि Rakshasas, आवाहयामास conjured, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, ददर्शह saw.

40016611.author: Translation
40016611.content: Hearing the words of Indra, Brahma conjured the Rakshasas and saw Kumbhakarna with them.

40016612.author: पदार्थः
40016612.content: कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, समीक्ष्यैव beholding, प्रजापतिः Brahma, वितत्रास alarmed, स्वयम्भूः Brahma, दृष्टवा seeing, विश्वास्यचैवैनम् to restore confidence, इदं, this अब्रवीत् spoke.

40016612.author: Translation
40016612.content: "Beholding Kumbhakarna, Brahma was alarmed and spoke to him to restore the confidence of Kumbhakarna."

40016613.author: पदार्थः
40016613.content: लोकविनाशाय for the destruction of the universe, पौलस्त्येन by Paulastya, निर्मितःअपि begotten, ध्रुवम् surely, तस्मात् therefore, त्वम् you, अद्यप्रभृति remain from today, मृतकल्पः sleep like a dead one, शयिष्यसे lying down.

40016613.author: Translation
40016613.content: "Surely you are begotten by Paulastya for the destruction of the universe. Therefore, remain sleeping like a dead one from today, ' said Brahma and cursed him."

40016614.author: पदार्थः
40016614.content: अथ and then, ब्रह्मशापाभिभूतः by the curse of Brahma, प्रभोः Lord, अग्रतः front, ततः then, परमसम्भ्रान्तः highly agitated, रावणः Ravana, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40016614.author: Translation
40016614.content: "Thereafter, by the curse of Lord Brahma, Kumbhakarna fell in front. Highly agitated at this Ravana spoke these words to Brahma."

40016615.author: पदार्थः
40016615.content: प्रजापते Brahma, विवृद्धः developing, काञ्चनःवृक्षः golden tree, फलकाले at the stage of fruiting, निकृत्यते cutting, स्वकम् by you, नप्तारम् great grandson, एवम् in that way, शप्तुम् son, न न्यायम् not proper.

40016615.author: Translation
40016615.content: "Oh Brahma! Cutting a golden tree at the stage of fruiting is not fair. It is not proper for you to curse your great grandson in that way."

40016616.author: पदार्थः
40016616.content: त्वम् by you, मिथ्यावचनः untrue, न च not be, संशयः न no doubt, स्वप्स्यत्येष sleep he must, अस्य his, शयने sleep, तथा like that, जागरे waking, कालः time, क्रियताम् may be fixed.

40016616.author: Translation
40016616.content: "Your words will not become untrue, no doubt. Sleep, he must but waking time may be fixed."

40016617.author: पदार्थः
40016617.content: रावणस्य Ravana's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, स्वयम्भूः Brahma, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke, एषः if, षट् six, मासान् months, शयिताहि he sleeps, एकाहम् one day, जागरिष्यति will be awake.

40016617.author: Translation
40016617.content: On hearing Ravana's words, Brahma said" He will sleep for six months and stay awake for a day."

40016618.author: पदार्थः
40016618.content: असौवीरः This hero, एकेन alone, आह्ना mouth, बुभुक्षितः will consume, भूमिम् the earth, चरन् moving about, व्यात्तास्यः opening the mouth wide, सङ्कृद्धः like the swollen fire, पावकःइव like fire, लोकान् the world, भक्षयेत् will consume.

40016618.author: Translation
40016618.content: "This hero will open his mouth wide and move about and alone he will consume the world like the swollen fire."

40016619.author: पदार्थः
40016619.content: व्यसनम् worry, आपन्नः overtaken, राजा king, सः he, असौ is, रावणः Ravana, त्वत्पराक्रमभीतः च by the fear of your prowess, सम्प्रति sleeping, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, अबोधयत् is awakened.

40016619.author: Translation
40016619.content: "Overtaken by worry, the king out of fear of your prowess just awakened sleeping Kumbhakarna."

40016620.author: पदार्थः
40016620.content: भीमविक्रमः fierce valour, सः he, एषः if, वीरः heroic, शिभिरात् from his residence, निर्गतः come out, भृशसङ्कृद्धः extremely angry, वानरान् Vanaras, भक्षयन् to consume, परिधावति going to and from.

40016620.author: Translation
40016620.content: "This heroic Kumbhakarna has come out of his residence extremely angry and going to and from to consume all Vanaras."

40016621.author: पदार्थः
40016621.content: अद्य running, हरयः monkeys, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, प्रतीक्ष्यैव on seeing itself, प्रविद्रुतुः, रणे war, क्रुद्धम् angry, एनम् these, वानराः Vanaras, कथम् how, वारयिष्यन्ति check.

40016621.author: Translation
40016621.content: "On merely seeing Kumbhakarna, the monkeys are running away. How will they check him who is enraged in war?"

40016622.author: पदार्थः
40016622.content: एतत् this, समुच्छ्रितम् standing high, यन्त्रम् machine, सर्वे all, वानराः Vanaras, उच्यन्ताम् having told, हरयः Vanaras, इति this, विज्ञाय victory, निर्भयाः not scared, इह here, भविष्यन्ति will be.

40016622.author: Translation
40016622.content: "Let all the Vanaras be told, that this one standing high is a machine then the Vanaras will not be scared of victory."

40016623.author: पदार्थः
40016623.content: सुमुखेरितम् which was in favour, हेतुमत् reasonable, विभीषणवचः Vibheeshana's words, श्रुत्वा hearing, राघवः Raghava, तदा then, सेनापतिम् commander in chief of army, नीलम् Nila, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच said.

40016623.author: Translation
40016623.content: Hearing the words of Vibheeshana, which was reasonable and, in their favour, Raghava said this to Nila, the commander in chief of the army.

40016624.author: पदार्थः
40016624.content: पावके Pavaka (the son of fire god), गच्छ go, सर्वाणि all, सैन्यानि army, व्यूह्य organizing, लङ्काया Lanka, द्वाराणि gates, चर्याश्चापि highways, अथ and, सङ्क्रमान् bridges, आदाय getting together, तिष्ठ occupying.

40016624.author: Translation
40016624.content: "Pavaka, go and organize all the army and get together to occupy all the gates, highways, bridges in Lanka."

40016625.author: पदार्थः
40016625.content: शैलशृङ्गाणि mountain tops, वृक्षांश्च trees also, शिलाश्चापि rocks too, उपसंहार be ready, सर्वे all, सायुधाः armed with weapons, शैलपाणयः rocks in hand, तिष्ठन्तु stay.

40016625.author: Translation
40016625.content: "Be ready staying on mountain tops, trees, rocks armed with weapons and rocks in hand."

40016626.author: पदार्थः
40016626.content: राघवेण by Raghava, समादिष्टः instructed, हरिचमूपतिः monkey leader, कपिकुञ्जरः elephant among monkeys, नीलः Nila, वानरानीकम् monkey troops, यथावत् as instructed, शशास ordered.

40016626.author: Translation
40016626.content: As instructed by Raghava, the monkey leader Nila, elephant among the monkeys, ordered the monkey troops as instructed.

40016627.author: पदार्थः
40016627.content: ततः then, शैलाभाः mountains, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, शरभं Sarabha, हनूमन् Hanuman, तथा so also, अङ्गदः Angada, शैलशृङ्गाणि looked like mountains, गृहीत्वा taking, द्वारम् gate, अभ्ययुः marched.

40016627.author: Translation
40016627.content: Then taking mountains, Gavaksha, Sarabha, Hanuman, Angada who looked like mountains themselves marched to the gate.

40016628.author: पदार्थः
40016628.content: जितकाशिनः desiring to be triumphant, हरयः monkeys, रामवाक्यम् Rama's command, उपश्रुत्य hearing, वीराः heroes, वानराः Vanara, पादपैः trees, परवाहिनीम् enemies, अर्धयन् began to strike.

40016628.author: Translation
40016628.content: The monkeys desiring to be triumphant, took trees and began to strike at the enemies on hearing Rama's control.

40016629.author: पदार्थः
40016629.content: ततः then, शैलोद्यतदीप्तहस्तम् taking trees and rocks in their shining hand s, हरीणाम् the Vanaras, उग्रम् front, तत् that, गिरेः mountain, समीपानुगतम् close to each other, उग्रम् terrible, महत् huge, महाम्भोधरजालंयथैव like mass of clouds hanging, रराज seemed.

40016629.author: Translation
40016629.content: Then Vanaras taking trees and mountains in their shining hand s marching close to each other seemed like a huge mass of terrible clouds hanging close to a mountain. ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेषष्टितमस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the sixty first sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
